intro: Katoom the Angler, from Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands, has lost his best lure to Gammerita, the head of the saltwater snapjaws. You are asked to find her and get it back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.
Mon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.
Find Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.

clips.title: Completion
paras: MON! This is fantastic! With my best lure and the snapjaw population down, the fish will pile up.
